new_web_content.title: London hotel Thames-view booking prep
new_web_content.text:
London Hotel with Thames View — Booking Prep
Stay dates: 28–30 May 2024

Requirement
The hotel must have guest reviews that explicitly mention views of the River Thames.

Workflow
1. Use the hotel search tool to pull up London options (e.g., Cozy Stay, Mom's Home, London Luxury, Covent Garden Retreat, Riverside View).
2. Retrieve reviews for those hotels and check for explicit Thames view mentions.
3. Reserve the qualifying hotel for the requested dates.
